svg.title: Buff Your Money: data model
svg.desc: User: An owner identified by the AgentBuff subject, a household member with email and password, or a throwaway demo account. Space (book): A household or business book; the tenant key for every data table, with payday period settings, base currency and frozen state. Space member: Links a user to a space with a role and the choice of whether their records are included for the agent. Wallet: Cash, bank, e-wallet, credit card, investment, asset or debt account; shared or private, with a cached balance recomputed from the ledger. Transaction: A signed amount in minor units with category, payee, tags, source (manual, quick entry, agent, import) and review status; transfer legs are paired and every change is kept in a history table. Budget and goal: Budget per category per period with rollover, and goals funded from a dedicated wallet or a virtual pocket. Recurring item: Bills, subscriptions, salary and routine transfers with a schedule and generated occurrences. Debt: Mortgage, card, paylater or personal loan with terms and payments split into principal and interest; arisan has its own rounds. Holding and price: Investment holdings per instrument with buy and sell records, prices and daily net worth snapshots. MCP token: SHA-256 hash of the token, scope, extra permission for bulk changes, source (manual or automatic), expiry and last use. Agent action: What each agent write created or changed, with the previous state, used to undo it within 30 days. Idempotency record: Space, tool, client_ref, argument hash and stored result for 30 days, written in the same transaction as the change.
